name: rules
purpose: A rule system as data: the first row of a table whose "when" lists hold the inputs wins. Gives the row, its "out", and "alts" (what other rows give) as wrong options for a gate.
returns: the row fields (for example name, sutra, why), out, and alts

table.doc: the name of a list in tables; each row is {when: {key: [values]}, out: "template {key}", ...more fields}

alts.doc: how many options, the right one included
